name: Echo Test — 2 node pipeline
description: Minimal real dispatch test. Node 1 writes a file, node 2 reads it and reports. Proves engine dispatches real cards, real profiles pick them up, real completion advances the workflow.

nodes.body_template:
Write the string 'hello from workflow engine' to /tmp/wf-engine-test-output.txt

This is a test card from the workflow engine. Just write the file and complete the card with metadata: {file_written: true, content: 'hello from workflow engine'}

Read /tmp/wf-engine-test-output.txt and verify it contains 'hello from workflow engine'.

This is a test card from the workflow engine. Read the file, confirm the content, and complete with metadata: {verified: true, content_found: 'hello from workflow engine'}
